intent: Provide provider-neutral, zero-write results across research-pipeline intake, research, evidence synthesis, thesis expression, user gates, and graduation planning while composing the ordered aggregate and contracting superseded legacy procedures to rollback-capable protective tombstones.
contract: Given one explicit Trade Journal research insight, return independently invocable, deterministic, bounded, zero-write results for pipeline_status, idea_intake, thesis_formalization, unknown_mapping, research_preparation, unknown_research, evidence_synthesis, thesis_expression, gate_decision, or graduation, or compose exact stage results with Registry-locked claims-synthesis, research-publication, belief-research-relation, and thesis-underwriting dependencies into the ordered aggregate lifecycle. Notes/Tana owns capture, source material, and Toulmin extraction. Trade Journal stage results preserve exact provenance, source-linked evidence, reasoning, backing, qualifier, every rebuttal, time horizon, contradictions, ambiguity, audit context, idempotency, and genuine user judgment without persisting anything. Research preparation is portable and provider-neutral; unavailable research remains unavailable; evidence synthesis retains unresolved contradictions; expression provides no position size or trade instruction; gate recommendations remain judgment_required until the user records an audited decision; graduation is a provenance-bound handoff plan that remains judgment_required until the user accepts its exact digest, preserves decline as refused, proposes initial lifecycle developing, and has no persistence or status authority. The aggregate remains coordination-only and zero-write. The ten former Claude procedures and ten headless projections are protective tombstones that preserve their discovery paths and exact governed replacements but cannot execute legacy file or database persistence; rollback remains available from accepted pre-contraction revision 051c1c57c9dd447c930e4352262d6c4cd6f90fe2. No stage, aggregate, or tombstone has scheduler, credential, production-data, status, Decision Item resolution, signal configuration, strategy, position, order, trade, generic write, or database authority.
instructions: Require one explicit research insight UUID. Build the ten stage results through scripts/research-pipeline.ts --pipeline-status, --idea-intake, --thesis-formalization, --unknown-mapping, --research-preparation, --unknown-research, --evidence-synthesis, --thesis-expression, --gate-decision, or --graduation with <file|-> input; validate stage bytes with --validate-stage-result. Describe, evaluate, and validate the aggregate through --describe, --evaluate, and --validate-result.

Use the exact ordered lifecycle: pipeline_status, idea_intake, thesis_formalization, unknown_mapping, research_preparation, unknown_research, evidence_synthesis, claims_synthesis, research_publication, belief_research_relation, thesis_expression, gate_decision, graduation.

Validate and compose all ten package-owned stages through their stage-result validators. Resolve claims-synthesis, research-publication, belief-research-relation, and thesis-underwriting only through the published Registry Lock. Preserve exact digests; do not copy stage or dependency validators into the aggregate.

Preserve exact (sourceInsightId, sourceClaimId) provenance, evidence, reasoning, backing, qualifier, every rebuttal, time horizon, ambiguity, relationship rationale, and digest-bound user judgment audit (decision ID, actor ID, recorded-at time) through the stage-owned contracts. Reuse provenance-bearing claims. Holdings, tickers, keywords, or provider recommendations are never semantic proof.

Every stage result uses execution mode stage_result_only with writes: []. The aggregate uses aggregate_coordination_only with writes: []. Neither can create files, publish claims, persist relationships, change status, create or resolve Decision Items, mutate theses or signals, configure signals, mutate strategies, positions, orders, or trades, or use ad-hoc SQL, Supabase MCP writes, direct API mutation, generic writers, schedulers, credentials, provider discovery, or production-data evidence.

When research-publication returns its exact judgment boundary, report judgment_required and name only scripts/ops/publish-research.ts --stdin. When belief-research-relation returns its exact recording judgment boundary, report judgment_required and name only scripts/ops/record-belief-research-relation.ts --stdin. Never invoke either operation or create an authorization token from aggregate authority.

Represent missing stage material as incomplete; unavailable prerequisites as unavailable; digest or freshness mismatch as stale; policy, malformed authority, or user refusal as refused; provider or execution failure as failed; genuine unresolved user judgment as judgment_required; and a validated zero-write stage result as ready. Research uses at least two independent source domains and explicit HTTPS citations. Evidence synthesis requires exact unknown coverage, retains contradictions, and derives advance, hold, kill, or modify from decision-critical resolution and posterior confidence. Expression requires an audited user entry decision, recommends no position size, and leaves act, watch, or discard to the final user gate. Graduation reuses exact provenance, depends on locked governed capabilities, and prepares only a developing thesis handoff; monitoring remains expression-cascade derived. Do not collapse partial progress into success.

Keep all ten former Claude discovery paths and ten headless projections as protective tombstones. Each tombstone names its exact governed CLI flag, refuses the removed legacy procedure, performs no writes, and preserves historical rollback to accepted pre-contraction revision 051c1c57c9dd447c930e4352262d6c4cd6f90fe2. Do not perform the final provider-discovery cutover owned by issue #76.

Retry only canonically identical aggregate input. The aggregate digest is the retry key. A changed input, source digest, stage result, authorization boundary, package binding, or adapter binding is a new evaluation, not a retry.

Unattended use is conditional only for read-only pipeline status, portable preparation, validation of explicitly supplied evidence, and aggregate describe, evaluate, and validation modes through the governed adapter. Provider research may run only with declared source access and must report unavailable environments honestly. Idea selection, thesis classification, every user gate, graduation acceptance, and every accepted write remain interactive and ineligible. Tombstones are never execution authority.

requirements.description: Four independently invocable stage-result contracts preserve Notes/Tana provenance and Toulmin semantics, require exact user judgment, reject inferred bearing and writes, and bind deterministic stage chaining.

Six independently invocable research, synthesis, expression, gate, and graduation results preserve source provenance, multi-track source diversity, all-unknown coverage, contradictions, genuine judgment, no-size/no-trade behavior, exact claim-resolution bindings, dependency availability, and exact zero-write chaining.

Exact Claude and Codex aggregate adapters are present in staged governed Provider Entry Points while every former discovery path remains as a non-executable protective tombstone with an exact replacement.
The result contract is bounded, deterministic, ordered, digest-bound, zero-write, and explicitly reports incomplete, unavailable, stale, refused, failed, judgment_required, and ready outcomes.

Claims synthesis, research publication, belief-research relation, and thesis underwriting are resolved through exact Registry-locked contracts and existing validators without duplicated semantics or mutation authority.
The aggregate has no database or operational authority and can name only the exact stage-owned publication or relation recorder behind its existing user authorization boundary.

All ten former Claude procedures and ten headless projections are contracted to exact, non-executable governed-replacement tombstones; public result metadata and declared active consumers route only to the governed CLI and separately authorized recorders, and rollback provenance remains explicit.
Exact Claude and Codex adapters preserve lifecycle, authority, provenance, source and environment limits, judgment, stage delegation, contraction, rollback, and zero-write semantics.
The repository runtime executes read-only stage, describe, evaluate, and validate modes while missing, stale, refused, failed, or unavailable prerequisites remain explicit without writes.
